hours: clock hour h = mean over h:00-h:59 local time; index 0..23

spread.rule: out and travel people are placed in proportion to jobs, scaled by k = residents_total / jobs_total (job cells stand in for shops, restaurants, schools and the roads between them)

method: BLS ATUS 2023+2024 microdata: every diary episode (TUCUMDUR24 - TUACTDUR24 .. TUCUMDUR24, minutes from 04:00) is assigned a place from TEWHERE: 1 home, 2 workplace, 3-11 and 30-32 out (someone else's home, restaurant, worship, store, school, outdoors, library, bank, gym, post office), 12-21 travel (car, walk, bus, train, bike, ferry, taxi, plane). TEWHERE is not asked for sleeping, grooming and personal activities (tier 01): those count as home. Other blanks and refusals are 'unknown' (<1%).

Shares are weighted by TUFINLWGT (each year halved), per clock minute, then averaged within each clock hour. Weekday = Mon-Fri diaries excluding holidays (TRHOLIDAY), weekend = Sat+Sun. Population = civilian non-institutional persons 15+, US-wide.

resHome[h] = share of persons 15+ at home; applied to all census residents, including children under 15 (who on school days are mostly at school: resHome overstates homes and understates schools on weekday daytimes).

jobsAtWork[h] = share of employed persons (TELFS 1-2, incl. those absent from work that day) at their workplace; applied to LODES jobs. LODES counts jobs, not workers (second jobs count twice), and places a job at the employer's establishment address.

Puget Sound adjustment (weekday): ACS B08302 departure + B08303 travel time give mean arrival at work (bin midpoints, 90+ min = 105) for the four counties vs the US; the weekday curves are shifted by the difference (-5 min). ACS B08301 worked-from-home share (23.6% local vs 15.1% US) scales jobsAtWork by (1-wfh_local)/(1-wfh_us) = 0.900 on both day types; the employed removed from workplaces are added back to resHome (times employed share of persons 15+).
out[h] and travel[h] are shares of all persons 15+; out + travel + resHome + atWorkAllPersons + unknown = 1.

Not modelled: tourists, students in dorms, overnight shift workers' sleeping place vs workplace geography, seasonal and weather effects, special events (the engine's stadium crowd stays separate). ATUS is national; only commute timing and WFH are localized.

atus.note: www.bls.gov returns 403 to scripted clients, so the zips are saved by hand into data/raw/diurnal/ when the scripted download fails; sha256 is of the files used, each checked with zip CRC

check.note: land cells (100 m, no 3x3 smoothing) by fallback FAA category 1-5 (<50, <500, <2500, <10000, >=10000 /km2)
